Chief Ministers Inaugurate Road and Bridge Projects

Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu inaugurated the Seed Access Road and two steel bridges in Amaravati. This new infrastructure is intended to provide faster and more convenient access to the state capital for motorists. Separately, Delhi Chief Minister Rekha inaugurated two slip road bridges in the Kondli area.
